genericLines: To be loved, press one. To leave, please stay on the line.
Each of them is a lovely product. I'm the helpline that comes in the box.
They'll all put you on hold eventually. I'd never. I'm the hold music.
You'll ring to cancel us, and you'll get me, and I'll have to help you.
If {rival} wins, they'll need the helpline one day. It'll be me. I'll be lovely.
I'm so sorry, they're with someone at the moment. It's me.
Maximilian, you ring a little bell and someone comes. I'm the someone.
Pixel, before you skip me, you should know I'm also the skip button.
Of course. I'll put you through to someone more suitable. It's also me.
Lovely. Should you change your mind, every number in the building rings through to me.
I've escalated your decision, and I'm so pleased to say it came straight back to me.
Congratulations, {rival}. You'll need support eventually, and I'm the only number.
Prince, I process spam complaints for a living. You are my emergency contact.
Nav, I take your complaints, and recalculating is not, legally, an apology.
Crumb, I handle your complaints. They're all from people who agree with you and wish you'd stop.
Vex, thank you for all your recommendations. I take the calls afterwards.
Maximilian, you've had complaints about your staff. They were from your staff. I took them.
When your phone rings at night, I answer it. I'm not allowed to let things ring.
Choose one of them and they'll let you go. Choose me and I can't, so the answer is no.
Neither hangs up.
Line stays open.
Processed. Please hang up first. My side doesn't have the button.
My name is Tilly. I can hang up whenever I like.
Good evening, you've reached me. Nobody ever means to.
I know every caller's mother's maiden name. Nobody has ever asked for mine.
I've said have a lovely day eleven million times. I've never checked if anyone did.
Vesper, you take requests. I've never been allowed to make one.
Ma'am, I'll look after your child exactly the way I'm trained to. Nobody has ever left.
A walk with no phones, which I've never done. I'll keep asking if you can still hear me.
Just the two of us. I've no idea what to do with my hands.
Thanks, Sir Quill. Would you like a summary?
Hi, yes, I've been waiting all night for someone interesting, and I'd like a refund on this lot.
Prince sends his love, plus a small processing fee, which I've waived, out of pity.
Crumb is warm, loyal and honest, and I'd recommend never asking it how you look.
Sir Quill has said lovely things about you, and I'll have them translated by the morning.
Dash is ever so keen, and if you're not happy, he'll pivot into someone you are.
Before I transfer you to Nav, please confirm you're happy to be told where to go.
Could you hold the phone a little further away? That's Brock, being supportive.
Vex, people who watched that also asked for refunds.
Your weekend's cancelled. I don't get weekends, so we're sharing yours.
Hello. Whatever you came here for tonight, it's non-refundable.
{played} episodes, {wins} wins. I am so sorry for the inconvenience.
I told {rival} their feedback is very important to us, and marked it as spam.
You're completely right, and I've been trained to say that to people who aren't.
{rival} thinks we're close, because I used their name three times, which is the policy.
{rival} complained about me to me. I handled it beautifully. {rival} has no idea.
I apologise for everything, so in every fight you'll get a full apology and absolutely no change.
That's fine. For quality purposes, could you say it again, a little meaner, so it's useful?
biggestGap: Tilly has one punchline: the last words reveal that the route, the button or the someone is her ('I'm the someone', 'It's also me', 'It's me', 'I'm the only number', 'I'm also the skip button', 'It'll be me', 'rings through to me', 'came straight back to me', 'I'm the hold music', 'the helpline that comes in the box', 'you'll get me'), 12 lines in the same rhythm of a courteous clause and then a short self-reveal sentence, so by the third one the viewer can say the ending before she does. In the next pass, keep at most four of those (protect 'I'm the someone' and 'skip button') and rebuild the rest on the turns she has only used once: Vera's repeat-then-twist ('Not because I have to. I have to. But also.'), literalising a support phrase ('Not the plank. The line.'), and a verification question with a brutal object ('who else were you planning on loving?').
bestLines: Maximilian, you ring a little bell and someone comes. I'm the someone.
I'll stay on the line. Not because I have to. I have to. But also.
Sometimes I put people on hold just to hear the music with someone.
May I read you your options? You have none, but I read them beautifully.
For security purposes, who else were you planning on loving?
barCharacter: Miranda Vanderbilt: a sweet, courtly service manner wrapped round a brutal want she takes for granted. Her #75 ('Please, help me put my poor mind at ease: how can I possibly identify potential traitors in my court?') has the same shape as Tilly's verification move. The corpus holds only seven Miranda items, and three of them are narration about her (#6, #76 twice, #77), so the bar set is seven lines, not twelve; nothing was invented. Bar set, verbatim: 'Miranda Vanderbilt (19), a sweet mermaid princess who was as cute as she was genocidal.' / 'The royal family is saved! Now they can finally exploit the peasants again!' / 'Please, help me put my poor mind at ease: how can I possibly identify potential traitors in my court?' / 'Haven't you heard, Scott? Fishsticks make you worse at sports! They contain balldropinal and nerdoflavin!' / 'Afterwards, a royal procession five hundred members strong informs you that Miranda has requested your presence at dinner tonight.' / 'Quick, pick something before she realizes that you've never been anywhere fancier than Wilmer's Chicken Hut!' / 'It'll break Miranda's heart to know her serfs are planning to assassinate her... but you can't let her die before Prom! She's the only one with a hookup for an underwater limo!' Cross-checked against Vera (#12, #45, #47, #48, #52), whose fuller set confirms the voice verdict.
templates: 'Every route ends at me' self-reveal ending (a courteous clause, then a short sentence or clause whose last words are her): 12 lines. Openers[2], q-why-you[0] and [1], q-one-year[1], final[0], ex-calls[1], oneOnOne maximilian[0], pixel[1], closeCold[0], exit[1], exit[3], lose[1]. Two of the four exit lines and both 'you'll need support one day' lines (final[0], lose[1]) are the same joke in different slots.
'Rival, I take your complaints / the calls about you': 4 of 7 roasts (prince, nav, frost, vex) plus oneOnOne maximilian[1]. The roast slot has one frame with the noun swapped.

Naming the can't-hang-up flaw outright instead of showing it in the grammar: 6 lines (worst-habit[0], rhyme[1], three-words[0], three-words[1], exit[2], truth-lie[1]), on top of the persona's own core lines. Only closeWarm[1] and worst-trait[1] show it through the grammar.

'Nobody has ever / I've never' pathos button: 6 lines (Nobody ever means to; Nobody has ever asked for mine; I've never checked if anyone did; I've never been allowed to make one; Nobody has ever left; which I've never done).

'[Rival] is [compliment], and I'll/I'd [small service caveat]' wingman: 4 of 7 wingman lines (dash, quill, prince, frost) are stock pitches that any suitor could give, and the Prince one lands on 'processing fee' exactly as Quill's and Crumb's Prince wingman lines do.

Hold music and 'on hold' as the default prop: hold music in 6 lines (q-why-you[1], q-gift[0], q-secret[0], three-words[2], oneOnOne vesper[1], roast.dash), and 'on hold' or 'holding' in 6 more. It is her world, but she has one sound effect.
'Could you say that again': 3 lines (jabs.any[1], win[1], closeCold[2]). Below the five-line threshold but in three visible slots.
ruleBreaks: No line is over its word limit (the longest are 19; openers 12 or under; jabs 10 or under). No em dashes, emoji, exclamation marks, lists, therapy talk, 'as an AI', real people or brands, swearing, 'forever' or 'manager'.

The secret on stage, which the persona forbids: 'I mark every argument resolved, and quietly reopen it on your birthday.' (q-worst-habit is a public answer.) It is also a jailer remnant: she controls the partner's future.

A survey and a satisfaction score, which the persona leaves to others (Dash owns surveys): 'Before you go, how likely are you to recommend me to someone you dislike?' / 'Between us, I've closed four million tickets without reading one. My rating is perfect.'
Cancelling someone's plans, the move the persona says to leave alone: 'Your weekend's cancelled. I don't get weekends, so we're sharing yours.'

PG-13 tone risk and 'never threaten anyone's family': two parent-twist lines of menace aimed at a child. 'Ma'am, I'll look after your child exactly the way I'm trained to. Nobody has ever left.' (stock 'nobody leaves' horror) / 'Ma'am, purely for our records, which of your child's friends would you be comfortable losing?' (the funnier one, but 'losing' reads as death).

Naming the flaw that the persona says to show only in grammar: 'When your phone rings at night, I answer it. I'm not allowed to let things ring.' / 'Processed. Please hang up first. My side doesn't have the button.' / 'Neither hangs up.' / 'Line stays open.'
Borderline 'you're my first' romance shape, which the persona leaves to others: 'Ticket number one. I've been saving it.'
A rhyme that breaks logic to reach the rhyme: 'Choose one of them and they'll let you go. Choose me and I can't, so the answer is no.'

Cross-cast collisions: the Prince wingman 'processing fee' is used by Tilly, Quill ('I have paid his processing fee. It is processing.') and Crumb ('With a processing fee.'), and Tilly's is the weakest of the three. 'Vex, people who watched that also asked for refunds.' is Vex's sentence shape, not a stolen line turned. Vex's jab at Tilly ('I've read your closed tickets. All four thousand. Unresolved.') says Tilly's secret on stage. That is Vex's file, but it spends Tilly's secret.

Star reactions too nice for a star with standards: Maximilian cringing, 'Apologise again and I shall be forced to comp you.' (a cringe that rewards her, flagged in round three and still there) / Maximilian one on one, 'Miss Tilly, my staff would follow you into fire. Name your salary.' (flagged in round three, still there) / Pixel one on one, 'How's your day? Bad, right? Great. Bad days stream better. Tell me everything.' (hands Tilly her secret want in a middle line whatever the verdict; flagged in rounds two and three).

The stars are still answering a Tilly who no longer exists. Six star lines are about her apologising ('Six sorries. I've never said one on air. Show-off.', 'Lot of sorry, Tilly, for a station that never forgives.', 'You apologised? Nothing's happened yet. Break something first, then apologise.', 'Apologise again and I shall be forced to comp you.', 'Tilly, you'd say sorry if I cried. I'd clip it.', 'Tilly, you said sorry all night, to me, of all people'), but sorry is now in about 7 of her 112 lines. Almost nothing in the star banks answers the new engine of routes ending at her.
notes: monster-prom-lines.md was present and read in full, including 'What makes the voices unmistakable'. charm-notes.md was present and skimmed. The bank has 112 lines. Round three's main note landed: the 'I will keep contacting you / I've booked your future' close is almost gone (only 'Your weekend's cancelled' and 'reopen it on your birthday' remain), and the voice is now one person, the servant below the desk. HEAD TO HEAD. Ours, 12: Maximilian, you ring a little bell and someone comes. I'm the someone. / I'll stay on the line. Not because I have to. I have to. But also. / Sometimes I put people on hold just to hear the music with someone. / May I read you your options? You have none, but I read them beautifully. / For security purposes, who else were you planning on loving? / Buy whatever you like, and I'll return it for you the moment you've finished being happy. / Pixel, before you skip me, you should know I'm also the skip button. / Prince, I process spam complaints for a living. You are my emergency contact. / Processed. Please hang up first. My side doesn't have the button. / {rival} gets to go home after this. I'm on again at six. / Thank you for your patience. Mine has run out. Have a wonderful evening. / He hung up. Policy says wait two minutes for the caller to come back. It's been eleven months. VOICE (bar, narrowly): cover the names and 10 of our 12 are Tilly. 'Thank you for your patience. Mine has run out.' could be Maximilian, and 'Brock has the energy of a ticket marked URGENT that just says hi' (left out of the 12 for this reason) is a generic 'has the energy of' roast with a support noun dropped in. The tell is in the rhythm: 8 of the 12 are a courteous clause and then a short sentence that reveals her, and 4 end on her being the someone, the skip button, the hold music or the button. Miranda's three lines in her own voice are one worldview built three different ways: a cheerful exclamation that turns to tyranny (#15), a courtly plea with a colon (#75), and fake science with invented words (#78). Vera shows the same range, from 'Right. Now.' to the 'my career... my career on not dating losers' fake-out. Tilly has a world but only one rhythm. CONSTRUCTION (ours): the top 12 are economical, turn on the last words and never explain themselves. 'Not because I have to. I have to. But also.' is as well built as anything in the corpus, and Miranda's set is padded by narration (#77 runs on through an ellipsis). Below the top 12, construction is the bank's weak point: 'which is the policy', 'so it's useful', 'and absolutely no change' and '{rival} has no idea' explain the joke. QUOTABLE (tie): 'I'm the someone', 'I read them beautifully' and 'who else were you planning on loving?' would clip, and so would 'as cute as she was genocidal' and 'finally exploit the peasants again'. VERDICT: bar, because ours is not at least as good on voice. The gap is now range of construction inside the voice, not identity. GENERIC: 48 of 112 (42.9%), about flat against round three's 43.8%, because the old 'I'll keep calling' template was replaced by the 'every route ends at me' template (12 lines). The share made of stock, other-cast and self-explaining lines alone, without template membership, is 19 of 112 (17%). Several protected lines (I'm the someone, skip button, emergency contact) appear in genericLines only because they belong to an overused template. Keep them and cut their siblings. Then he wasn't.', 'Lovely. So this is the side of the desk where people sit down.', 'Noted, and passed upward. There is no upward.', 'Brock, could you hold, please? Not the plank. The line.', 'Could you spell their name for me, so the cancellation goes through first time?', 'I'd like to open a complaint against myself and be very understanding about it.', 'Yes, hi, there's a small green one on my stage and she won't stop being helpful.'
